title: Exact Hypergraph Duality for Multi-Rate Lattice Sampling under Common-Mode Drift
description:
A periodic system with period T is sampled by grids (the divisors of T above one), and each grid seats the divisors of T in blocks of section classes. This package answers, in exact rational arithmetic and with zero dependencies:

  • the maximum phase margin of a period, nu(T) = min_{d in U(T)} psi(d)/d, in closed form from the prime factorization of T;
  • the cheapest design reaching a requested margin, as an exact hypergraph coverage problem solved by dynamic programming;
  • the fewest shared sections that hold that margin, as an exact set cover over the divisor universe;
  • a formal infeasibility certificate for any margin above nu(T), which no budget can buy.

Every value is an int or a fractions.Fraction. No floating point appears anywhere, so no optimum is decided by rounding.
